```json
{
  "summary": "Fixed a critical bug in AgentSessionService constructor where parseInt used radix 3 instead of 10. This caused incorrect parsing of the NEZHA_MAX_SESSIONS environment variable - numbers like '10' would parse as 3.",
  "learnings": [
    {"topic": "parseInt usage", "reminder": "Always use radix 10 for parseInt when parsing decimal numbers. The second parameter is the radix (base), not a default value."},
    {"topic": "Environment variable parsing", "reminder": "When parsing env vars with parseInt, always use radix 10: parseInt(process.env.VAR ?? 'default', 10)"},
    {"topic": "Code review checklist", "reminder": "Verify all parseInt/parseFloat calls use correct radix parameter"}
  ],
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "critical",
      "type": "bug",
      "description": "parseInt used radix 3 instead of 10 - this would parse '10' as 3, '11' as 4, etc. Any session limit >= 3 would be incorrectly clamped.",
      "location": "src/services/AgentSessionService.ts:24"
    }
  ],
  "praise": [
    "The bug was caught and fixed",
    "The ?? operator correctly handles both undefined env var and empty string case",
    "Good use of default value '3' when env var is not set"
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Consider adding a unit test for this constructor to verify maxSessionsPerType is parsed correctly",
    "Add validation that maxSessionsPerType is > 0"
  ],
  "overallScore": 90,
  "codeQualityScore": 85,
  "testCoverageScore": 70,
  "documentationScore": 90
}
```
